0.original: Warin has work for an adventurer willing to exterminate the coblyns attacking ore wagons.

1.original: A swarm of coblyns has taken to attacking ore wagons inside a tunnel south of Black Brush Station. Warin has given you a silver ore cluster, which you must use to lure out the creatures and slay them.

2.original: You have purged the tunnel of coblyn presence, thus ensuring the security of future shipments. Return to Black Brush Station and inform Warin of your success.

3.original: Thanks to your martial prowess, the ore will continue to flow and feed Ul'dah's insatiable hunger for ore.

48.original: Let's get to it then, shall we?

49.original: Ore wagons pass through this station every day─but not without incident.

50.original: Wagons coming and going from the Dispatch Yard to the south must pass through a tunnel by Fesca's Watch─a tunnel in which some <hex:021A020203>genius<hex:021A020103> saw fit to put an ore storehouse, creating ideal conditions for a coblyn nest!

51.original: So now the ore-loving beasts have taken up residence in a tunnel <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> dug, and we're practically delivering meals to their doorstep!

52.original: But no more. Inside the tunnel in question, you will find a narrow fissure where the coblyns hide. Use this silver ore cluster to lure out the creatures, then slay them.

53.original: Well done! It shan't be easy work to keep the tunnel free of coblyns, but our wagons should be able to go unmolested for a time.

54.original: Disruptions to ore shipments threaten not only the interests of Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern, but of Ul'dah herself. One might liken these train tracks to veins that bear our nation's lifeblood.

55.original: If only we had more <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D656EFF046D656E03> like you to lend a hand.

56.original: A soft skittering sound begins to echo in the tunnel...
